messages:
Mina: canary promo blocked for 21:00 UTC window — package-extract failing on several runners with "tar: truncated by 1 byte". deploy-bot auto-held.
Carlos: seeing it on ap-southeast-1 only. registry checksum matches builder. runners are streaming mismatched content on range requests.
DeployBot: Alert — promo 6012 auto-hold
  failed_job: package-extract
  sample-runner: ap-southeast-1-runner-4
infra-bot: Observability — origin returned 206 partial-range with short content-length 3 times between 1788879900-1788879980. possible multipart reassembly bug.
Mina: options: 1) pin previous artifact v3.0.1 2) reupload blobs from builder (fast but risk) 3) rebuild+upload (safe, may miss window). leaning to pin to keep window.
release-lead: +1 pin to v3.0.1. run quick smoke on affected runners before promote. add release note entry.
ops: will fetch blobs from builder, run sha256 checks, and prepare a manual-promote PR.
Carlos: quick smoke on v3.0.1 -> PASS on ap-southeast-1. no extract errors observed.
ops: created manual-promote PR-223. Command: `/deploybot manual-promote PR-223 lock-window 30m pin v3.0.1`
DeployBot: Manual promote queued; status: awaiting approval.
Mina: approved in-thread. note for release_notes: "Canary held and pinned to v3.0.1 due to truncated extract on ap-southeast runners; rebuild+reupload scheduled (see INF-1677)."
